about_the_game:
This is the official artbook of Tempest Rising, our love-letter to the golden era of the classic RTS games that you have been missing. 

Dive into the world of Tempest Rising with the exclusive XX-page digital artbook! This collection offers a unique behind-the-scenes look at the game's creation, featuring stunning hand-picked concept art, in-depth details on the three in-universe factions, and a comprehensive exploration of the game's war-torn world. With insider insights into the underlying conflict and the creative process that brought Tempest Rising to life, this artbook is the ultimate companion for RTS enthusiasts who have kept the genre thriving over the years.
